title: Developer for Network Systems
meta: Salary aligned with the market + typical French benefits (Health Insurance, 50% Transportation card)
html:
Wetin di work be

Di pesin wey we go hire go dey in charge of:

  • To design, build and sharpen di Network system components for Kyber make dem dey work well-well
  • To find and solve hard wahala wey concern performance, memory management, synchronisation and security
  • To do deep debugging (crash dump analysis, kernel debugging, stack analysis, and sometimes reverse engineering)
  • To write technical documentation wey clear and wey go last
  • To join hand for low-level architecture decisions and important code reviews
  • To dey follow wetin dey happen for Windows internals and system-level tools every time

Di technical skills wey you must get

  • You sabi network architecture and ecosystems well-well
  • You understand networking basics deep-deep (TCP/IP, UDP, congestion control, NAT traversal, encryption, streaming pipelines)
  • You sabi operating system concepts well (threads, scheduling, memory, I/O, sockets)
  • You don use network debugging and analysis tools with your own hand
  • You get experience wey you fit show for one or more of dis protocols: QUIC (e compulsory), WebRTC, HLS, RTMP, USB over IP
  • Programming languages : C / C++ / Rust / X86/x64
  • Tools & work environment : Git and di way wey team dey build software togeda

Who you be

  • You don do software development work for 5 to 10 years, and you don focus well-well on Network programming
  • You get experience for embedded systems or environments wey resources no plenty
  • You don work with media pipelines, real-time communication or streaming infrastructure before
  • You sabi kernel-level networking or transport wey dem build by demsef
  • You don work with systems wey dey run for different platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows, embedded OS)
  • You dey careful well-well, you fit work on your own, and you dey look every small detail; you get strong interest to solve technical wahala wey no easy at all
  • You fit share wetin you sabi and guide junior engineers
  • Skills wey go add sugar for your application : experience for system security or to make Windows components strong pass, background for reverse engineering or malware analysis, contributions to low-level or system open-source projects
  • Skills wey go add sugar for your application : experience for environments wey get strict conditions (real-time systems, systems wey no suppose fall, software wey security matter well-well)

How di interview go waka

  • First call (15 minutes) — Quick gist about wetin dey motivate you, whether you go fit di team, and we go answer your questions wey no be about tech.
  • Two technical/product interviews (1 hour each) — We go enter deep inside how you dey take solve problem, with our CTO and/or our lead solution architect
  • Meet di team, say hello — Free-free session make we see say we go flow well togeda.

Wetin we go give you

  • Projects wey get plenty technical work and wey go challenge your brain
  • Environment wey respect correct engineering sabi and wey focus on tech (no meeting or report wey no get sense)
  • Full freedom to take technical decisions
